body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 54817a4a8a88aa9481097de1a488ac4dd35436fc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change permits 3D toolpaths and posted G-code in aligned setups. I found no blocking defects.

- The part geometry, model heights, picked boundaries, and simulation target use the setup frame. Stock and work offsets stay in that frame.
- The tests compare an asymmetric part after an X half-turn with equivalent geometry that was transformed before import. Toolpaths and posted G-code match exactly. The tests also check for blocking warnings and simulation gouge cells.
- The refusals for other operation types, 2D area controls, tilted planes, and non-milling machines remain in place.
- The issue, decision record, commit subject, and Changelog line agree with the change. No UI files, snapshot images, goldens, dependencies, build scripts, or workflows changed.

Local checks used `.claude/worktrees/review-1858` and its own target directory. The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `62e1d36a655a71407ff7a9980057db3c8cc8197a` reported `Already up to date.` The PR contains that main commit. No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --no-run` passed.
`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed:

| Suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| App library | 314 | 0 | 1 |
| fixture_locate_stock | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| heights_fixtures | 8 | 0 | 0 |
| opframe_picks | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| opframe_seam | 8 | 0 | 0 |
| setup_align | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| setup_align_3d | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| setup_carry | 9 | 0 | 0 |
| stock_source_verdict | 22 | 0 | 0 |

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

I repeated both reported mutations locally:

1. Restored the original `setup_align.rs`. All five `flipped_` tests failed with exit code 101. They reported the original unsupported-operation refusal. After I restored the PR file, all six tests passed.
2. Restored only the original area-control refusal. `flipped_pocket3d_area_controls_match_baked_geometry` failed with exit code 101. After I restored the PR file, all six tests passed.

The area mutation gave this error:

```text
3D operation generates in Setup2: Machining("Cut: invalid machining parameters: setup 'Setup2' holds the part turned (part alignment) - area controls are not supported yet in an aligned setup")
```

The PR source was restored byte for byte. The worktree has no tracked changes. No golden files changed, so no golden comparison was required.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: The tests do not cover the original user model, every finishing pattern, or arbitrary alignment angles. No physical machine test was done. `crates/app/src/setup_align.rs` grew from 401 to 404 lines; this small increase does not block the review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
